### (1/5) Update the parser contract

**Severity:** `low`

The Badge icon parser must receive the existing warning collection to report unsupported style suffixes while preserving regular as the fallback. Apply this signature change with all four remaining suggestions in the atomic group.

```suggestion

```

proposed_comments.title: Restore the general fallback explanation
proposed_comments.body:
### Restore the general fallback explanation

**Severity:** `low`

The README currently explains fallback only for Icons, although the renderer also displays `fallback` whenever another registered model cannot render itself. Restore that general contract so readers understand what happens for every element.

```suggestion
When a model's `RendersItself` is false, its element shows its `fallback` instead. `AdaptiveFallbackRenderer` draws that fallback because the WinUI 3 renderer drops fallback content.

`AdaptiveContainerDecoratorRenderer` wraps the built-in container, column set, and column renderers to apply the container styles.
```

confidence.rationale: Pinned source directly establishes the behavior/documentation gap; low severity reflects diagnostics or documentation impact, not a rendering failure.
